args.title: AC-1: Customer filling in details reaches the overview with those details accepted
args.steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-in page|Sign-in page is displayed
2. Sign in as standard_user with valid credentials|Products page is displayed (login succeeded)
3. Click the first Add to cart button|Cart badge shows "1"
4. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
5. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
6. Enter first name "Jane", last name "Doe", postal code "12345"|Fields are filled in
7. Click Continue|The page transitions to Checkout: Overview; the details are accepted and no error is shown

args.title: AC-2: Finishing from the overview shows the thank-you message for any demo customer
args.steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-in page|Sign-in page is displayed
2. Sign in as performance_glitch_user with valid credentials|Products page is displayed (login succeeded)
3. Click the first Add to cart button|Item is added to cart
4. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
5. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
6. Enter first name "Jane", last name "Doe", postal code "12345"|Fields are filled in
7. Click Continue|Checkout: Overview page is displayed
8. Click Finish|The page displays "Thank you for your order!"
Note: Bug #122 (Active) — error_user cannot finish an order; a separate confirmation test (D25) covers that scenario and is expected to fail.
